messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed payloads with retries are not showing up as distinct events in the console, which makes backoff/fanout issues hard to debug. Repro steps below.

maria: Example: client does an immediate retry on 429, we see 1 successful request in console and no indication there were retries. headers I sent: `Authorization, Content-Type, X-RW-Client-Version` 

maria: Can we add a small, non-breaking header that SDKs can set on retries (eg `x-rw-retry-id` and `x-rw-retry-attempt`) so console can tie attempts together and the telemetry pipeline can surface retry counts?

dan: +1 for observability. we already have some sampling headers but they're not propagated on retries. what do others think about header names / privacy?

jess: Core runtime: exposing retry metadata is fine. prefer `x-rw-retry-id` (UUID per logical request) and `x-rw-attempt` (integer). please avoid anything PII.

akira: Go SDK: easy to add. question: should SDKs set the id on initial request or let server generate when it accepts? if client sets it we can capture pre-server failures (connect errors) too.

priya: Py SDK: agree with client-set id. we already have a request-id for logs — maybe reuse if present, otherwise generate. also +1 for `x-rw-attempt`.

theo: TS SDK: we can add opt-in behavior behind a flag defaulting to on for new major. but we need a migration plan so existing clients don't suddenly start sending new headers that might be stored in logging systems. any retention/compliance concerns?

jess: retention/compliance: header itself is safe (UUID+int). we should document it and ensure it's not logged in error payloads that go to external vendors. add a redaction rule in ingestion if needed.

maria: UX ask: console should show a small badge on request trace "retries: 2" and an expandable list of attempts with latency/errors. would make troubleshooting much faster.

dan: telemetry pipeline: we can tag spans with retry-id and aggregate. sampling needs thought — right now we sample per-request, which could split attempts across different samples. propose we annotate sampling decisions with `x-rw-sample-id` and propagate it on retries so samples keep together.

priya: hmm sampler propagation makes sense. but if sample-id is set per initial request, SDKs must ensure they don't lose it through redirects/follow-redirects.

akira: implement plan for Go: generate `x-rw-retry-id` + `x-rw-sample-id` on first try, attach `x-rw-attempt` on each try. also include small snippet in changelog.

theo: TS patch ready to add to next minor. will add feature flag and telemetry opt-out. also will emit debug log when retry headers are generated.

maria: Thanks. Can someone sketch the header format we agree on so I can file a console ticket?

jess: Sketch: `x-rw-retry-id: uuid-v4` | `x-rw-attempt: 1` | `x-rw-sample-id: base64(8bytes)` ; note sample-id length negotiable.

dan: pipeline TODOs: 1) accept headers from client SDKs 2) correlate spans by retry-id 3) expose retry-count in request timeline 4) ensure sampling decision follows sample-id 5) redact headers in public logs

maria: I'll open console+telemetry tickets and link SDK PRs once they're up. thanks all. :tada:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: New patch queued: go-sdk-add-retry-headers (#412) by akira — scheduled for canary at 1998765700

akira: pushed PR. small note: for lib users behind proxies, we fall back to generating a retry-id per attempt if we can't set header. documented in PR.

priya: PR review incoming from me. please include tests that ensure header is present for retry logic and not present when opt-out is used.

theo: opened TS PR and included console mock screenshots for how retry badge will look. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/789

maria: Great — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to validate console changes and confirm sampling behavior.

dan: ack. I'll invite runtime + infra.

jess: bringing a small ingestion change to handle sample-id parsing.

maria: thanks everyone, will post follow-ups in this thread after the meeting.
